summary: Draganfly Inc., a Canadian drone developer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 7, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a shareholder update call scheduled for August 10, 2026. The call will be led by CEO Cameron Chell to discuss recent milestones and strategic direction, with CFO Paul Sun reviewing Q2 2026 financial highlights. The company will release quarterly financial results after market close on August 10. This is a routine earnings-related shareholder communication and earnings call notice. No special-situation transaction, board change, or strategic action is disclosed. This is an ordinary event announcement, not a special situation.
